preference: Same-budget comparisons of test quality and observed time; retain every prespecified source and learner, including nulls and losses. A comparison of equal-budget selectors implies no difference in retained width.
source_policy: Five archived numeric CSVs checked against configs; sklearn datasets as distributed; diabetes unscaled. Crime uses only columns population through LemasPctOfficDrugUn. No feature selection or fitting using held-out rows. ISOLET sample splits are not speaker-blocked.
timing: Elapsed selection including witness construction plus backend train preprocessing/fit/predict. Data loading/splitting and evaluation excluded. Each selector measured independently; reuse its frozen support and measured selection time across the two learners. Single thread, randomized arm and backend order per split. No shared fitted estimators.
